body.label: Trigger
body.html: Your Locked target gains cover, leaves your weapon's normal range, or breaks line of sight during its Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Do not lose your Lock because of the triggering movement or cover until the end of that creature's turn.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense from cover or increase this Reaction's range by 2 units.
After this Reaction resolves, move 1 unit.
